notes.title: DENIAL is on Sale! Don't miss it out!
notes.content:
DENIAL is on on sale with huge  discount dont miss it out 80% off.

- Find your deepest fear inside your own mind.
- Discover secrets about yourself and their consequences. 
- Wander between mysterious places and find their evil reasons.
- Complete Missions and AI with death in his eyes. 
- Decide your own ending.

And for more enjoyment there is DLC - Survival mode included with his own short story.

notes.title: FREE DLC launch - Try it now!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the launch of survival mode!
Try it now!

Note: This is a free DLC and will be updated automatically to the main game.

DLC features:

•Survival mode, a brand new map with a brand new set of objectives, you'll have to find the most effective way to get what you need, if you want to live.

• A new AI, smarter, faster and deadlier. You can run, but you can't run far, and you can hide, but you can't hide for long... Can you survive until the end?

• Short story - not everything is as it seems, as you progress things will become clearer and clearer, can you find the right path?

DENIAL development team

notes.title: Announcing a release date for the new DLC
notes.content:
We are proud to announce a release date for our first DLC for DENIAL, and as a thank you to the community for it's support we are making it completely free to all past and future players.

What will be included in the DLC:

•Survival mode, a brand new map with a brand new set of objectives, you'll have to find the most
effective way to get what you need, if you want to live.

• A new AI, smarter, faster and deadlier. You can run, but you can't run far, and you can hide, but you can't
hide for long... Can you survive until the end?

• Short story - not everything is as it seems, as you progress things will become clearer and clearer, can
you find the right path?

Release date: 23/6/20 check out our page for more details 
Note: THIS DLC WILL BE AVAILABLE IMMINENTLY TO ALL PLAYERS UPON RELEASE.

Thank you for your support in our game and stay tuned for more in the future!

-DENIAL dev team
